Please Note: An Arbitrage Mutual Fund is a type of mutual fund that seeks to generate returns by exploiting price differences in different markets, such as different exchanges (as our example), or in the cash and futures market.
These funds capitalise on temporary mismatches in prices across these markets to create low risk profit opportunities.
Last year we made a video where we asked people in the office to tell us their short term goals.
This year we decided to see how they are doing and tried to break down some of the most common assets used for short term investments.
